About
DID YOU KNOW PGDM'27, Marketing — Great Lakes Institute of Management, Gurgaon

Jigyasa Prashar is a PGDM candidate specializing in Marketing at the Great Lakes Institute of Management, Gurgaon (Class of 2027), pursuing a career in advertising, brand management, and public relations. She recently completed a summer internship with Zeno Group's earned media and influencer marketing team, leading category communications for two international agricultural commodity boards and a consumer electronics brand. Prior to business school, she wrote on global technology and business affairs, and has contributed bylined as well as ghostwritten features to national food and lifestyle publications.

  • Earned media campaigns for Australian Avocados and Turkish Hazelnuts (via Ampro Marketing), and influencer marketing for Tecno Mobile's Pova Curve 2 IPL-season launch
  • Built a 200+ journalist media database used across client accounts
  • Coordinated the Australian Avocados culinary showcase at the School of European Pastry (SEP), Mumbai
  • Onboarded and briefed 17 influencers across Lucknow and Ahmedabad for Tecno's IPL activations; produced client-facing Excel coverage reports and Word deliverables
  • Developed South India expansion recommendations for Turkish Hazelnuts, targeting Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Chennai
  • Researched podcast and new-age platform opportunities for Nodwin Gaming and Tecno Mobile
  • Delivered all seven SIP milestones, weekly logbooks, a defence presentation, and the final report — "Category Communications in Practice: Earned Media Strategy for International Agricultural Commodity Boards and Influencer Marketing for a Consumer Electronics Brand in India"
